newsitem.title: USA: Sears November sales in line with its plan.
newsitem.headline: Sears November sales in line with its plan.

text.p: Sears, Roebuck and Co chairman and chief executive Arthur Martinez said on Thursday that sales so far this month are in line with expectations.
"At this point, we're right on plan," Maritnez said in an interview.
Sales among Sears stores open a year rose 5.3 percent in October and increased 5.1 percent during November of 1995.
"We're exactly where we thought we'd be," Martinez said. "We're not beating plan. We're not missing plan."

A cold snap in the Midwestern and some Eastern markets can be a plus for retailers at this time of year, he added. The snow storms that blanketed parts of Ohio, Michigan, New York and other states has not had much influence on business.
